cli.daemon_build.install_restarted.role: lop mobile/tunnel/browser install step: a daemon still running an old build was restarted onto the new one
cli.daemon_build.install_restarted.note: Indented progress step, lowercase like its sibling steps. 'service' is the background daemon the install manages. {generation} is a build/generation directory name such as 20260924T103058Z-509c7450dbf6; keep it verbatim.

cli.daemon_build.install_restarted_uncon.role: install step: the daemon was restarted because its running build could not be verified
cli.daemon_build.install_restarted_uncon.note: Must not claim the old build was stale, only that it could not be confirmed current.

cli.daemon_build.install_restart_failed.role: install step/error: a needed restart onto the new build did not happen
cli.daemon_build.install_restart_failed.note: {command} is a literal CLI command such as `lop mobile restart`; keep it and its backticks verbatim.

cli.daemon_build.install_unconfirmed.role: install step: the plist is current but the running daemon's build could not be checked, and it was not restarted
cli.daemon_build.install_unconfirmed.note: Replaces a false 'already current' claim; it must stay a hedge, not a warning of a proven fault. {command} is a literal CLI command such as `lop mobile restart`; keep it and its backticks verbatim.

cli.daemon_build.status_stale.role: lop mobile status / lop tunnel status line: the running daemon is provably on an older build
cli.daemon_build.status_stale.note: Printed alone on its own line, with no label before it; the service (mobile relay or tunnel connector) is its implied subject, so it must read as a complete status line without one. {generation} is a build/generation directory name such as 20260924T103058Z-509c7450dbf6; keep it verbatim. {command} is a literal CLI command such as `lop mobile restart`; keep it and its backticks verbatim.
